verdict.rationale: OpenAI's safety best-practices guide documents a free Moderation API for reducing unsafe content in completions. That is a first-party guardrail primitive and covers the core of the story. Structured Outputs adds a schema-enforced way to constrain output before downstream code acts on it. missing for 10: detail on moderation categories, thresholds or configurable safety settings, an explicit documented pattern for gating tool or agent actions on moderation results, and independent hands-on corroboration.
